description: Official-SEC identity corrections bounded to the mature 2025-plus full-market case dates.

decisions.rationale: The local listing combines the predecessor ticker CPSR with the successor company name during dates when SEC filings identify the traded common-stock ticker as GLS.

evidence.observed_fact: Gelesis states that predecessor CPSR changed its name in January 2022 and its common stock began trading under GLS on January 14, 2022.
